newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran launches 10-day air, sea exercises in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Iran launches 10-day air, sea exercises in Gulf.

text.p: Over 100 Iranian navy vessels backed by 40 airplanes and helicopters began a 10-day military manoeuvre in the Gulf region on Thursday, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.

It said Iran's two submarines, along with navy destroyers, missile cruisers, air force units and troops from the army and the Revolutionary Guards, were taking part in the manoeuvre, code-named "Piroozi (Victory)-7".
The exercise, conducted to raise the combat readiness of the forces, would cover an area stretching from the Strait of Hormuz at the mouth of the Gulf across the Gulf of Oman, IRNA said.

Iranian Navy Commander Rear Admiral Ali Shamkhani last week blasted the presence of Western navies in the Gulf as "a kind of occupation" but said the manoeuvre "does not challenge anyone and does not signal any tension".
Shamkhani said Iran's third Kilo-class Russian-built submarine would leave Russia for Iran on the first day of the exercise. He did not say when it was expected to arrive.

Iran -- which has repeatedly said its rearmament was only for self-defence purposes -- is the only Gulf state to deploy submarines in the Gulf region which has about 70 percent of the world's oil reserves.
